impossible_without_reveal.description: Show a character facing a problem that needs a pain (such as an upload limit or a locked file). Reveal the tool solving it without that pain, in three short steps on a panel.
impossible_without_reveal.hook_pattern: This [gadget or tool] does [impossible-sounding thing] without [usual requirement]

numbered_list_explainer.description: Use a narrator and a counter caption to run through N quick file-fixes, each one a tiny 3D scene with a before and after size panel.
numbered_list_explainer.hook_pattern: N new [things] in [trending update] you need to know
